description: Frozen eval for the agent-fleet UserPromptSubmit hook's string match (plugins/agent-fleet/hooks/inject.sh), NOT for the skill description. The hook's stated intent is to inject when the prompt *invokes* deep-research or ultracode; it matches the surface strings, so this set separates invocation from mention. Item 5 is not designed: it is a prompt observed in the wild on 2026-08-20 that fired the hook during a conversation that orchestrated nothing, transcribed byte-for-byte including its typos. Freeze means: commit this file, record its sha256 in every run's eval_sha256, and never edit it — a change starts a new benchmark.
